title: Weekly digest 2026-W43: 104 items this week
summary: Index of 104 items: Methode 41, Kouka 21, Lacia 16, Snowdrop 13, Saturnus 13.
summary_en: Weekly index of 104 items, sorted by column. Titles are listed as published; Chinese items carry their own English summaries in their cards.
